long_biography.plain_text:
Ali İsmail Sabancı began at Morgan Stanley and Akbank before joining the wider Sabancı family conglomerate, where he worked in projects, strategy and business development. He later moved to ESAS, the separate investment group founded by his father, Şevket Sabancı, and became closely associated with the growth of Pegasus Airlines.

Sabancı became ESAS chairperson in 2020 and now guides a platform spanning private equity, real estate and investment management. He left the Pegasus chair in 2023 but remains a director there and at ESAS Properties. His personal ESAS stake is not publicly quantified; group funds, properties and portfolio-company assets are not treated as his direct holdings.
